name: niagara-agent-skills
description: Agent skills that operate a Niagara 4 host through its own command-line tools (plat, nre, service control, offline config.bog edits) with allowlists, confirmation gates and an audit trail.

interface.shortDescription: Stations, modules, daemon and logs on Niagara 4 hosts, safely, from an agent.
interface.longDescription: Thin, audited wrappers over Niagara's own plat.exe and nre.exe plus Windows service control and offline config.bog editing. Host allowlist, credential providers, confirmation gates for destructive tiers, dry-run everywhere, JSON output, and the same scripts run locally on the host or over SSH.
defaultPrompt: List the stations on the local Niagara host.
Restart station demo and tail its console until it starts.
Install STierAPI-rt.jar on host jace-1 and verify the module loads.
